title: Versioned integration API and event contract
scope: Publish OpenAPI schemas for cases, evidence, entities, findings, investigate and request-evidence; include case mapping, tenant context, idempotency and errors

acceptance.text: Publish OpenAPI schemas for cases, evidence, entities, findings, investigate and request-evidence; include case mapping, tenant context, idempotency and errors
Validate schema and five example request/response pairs; reject missing tenant and case IDs
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Validate schema and five example request/response pairs; reject missing tenant and case IDs

evidence.text: integration/api/openapi.json (OpenAPI 3.1.1) defines 8 /api/v1 operations: createCase, getCase, startInvestigation, listEvidence, registerDocument, listEntities, listFindings, requestEvidence; required X-Vati-Tenant-ID on every operation, service_links case mapping with sync state, Idempotency-Key on every mutation plus expected_version on state updates, ErrorResponse on all 4xx/5xx, EventEnvelope schema. Observed: python3 integration/api/contract.py -> 'Vati OpenAPI contract valid: 16 HTTP examples, 2 events' (lint_spec found 0 errors). Decisions recorded in docs/decisions/ADR-003-vati-api-contract.md.

Validated 10 success request/response pairs covering SYN-001..SYN-005 and all 8 operations, plus 6 error contracts (missing tenant 400, empty case_id 400, tenant scope 403, stale version 409, idempotency conflict 409, upstream timeout 503) and 2 events. Observed: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/contracts -> Ran 25 tests OK, including missing tenant header rejected on every operation (missing_tenant_context), malformed tenant rejected, empty/non-UUID case_id rejected (invalid_case_id), events without tenant_id/case_id rejected. python3 scripts/dev.py check -> Workspace checks passed; python3 scripts/quality.py -> First-party quality checks passed.

notes.text: Agent finished implementation and opened human review
